scope: Independent offline baseline, not an installed release or a hardware/competitor ranking.

desktop_binary.scope: offscreen --version only; excludes window initialization, first frame, responsiveness and readiness

boundaries.wall_ms: MCP request write to complete raw JSON line received, excludes verifier and proc sampling
boundaries.wire_utf8_bytes: actual complete JSON-RPC response line including newline; image files separate
boundaries.cold: fresh MCP or CLI process; OS page cache NOT flushed; same isolated data home
boundaries.warm: sequential calls on same MCP server; warm_cached OCR repeats exercise content cache; warm_fresh_image changes pixels outside labelled target and asserts engine_runs>0
boundaries.rss: Linux /proc 10ms sampled sum of MCP + fixture worker + descendants; shared pages counted per process; not a guaranteed peak
boundaries.cpu: Linux proc user+system + waited children and live descendants; coarse clock ticks; excludes client CPU
boundaries.observer: A background /proc sampler runs every 10ms during requests; observer scheduling/CPU overhead can affect timings
boundaries.p95: nearest rank ceil(.95*n); with n<20 this is the observed maximum, not a stable production-tail estimate
boundaries.correctness: PNG hash+geometry, known late tree target retained, action verified by hierarchy postcondition, OCR labelled target matches

ocr_engine.standard_route: TOMACCO_TESSERACT absent; PATH resolves /usr/bin/tesseract after hardware traps
ocr_engine.custom_route: same executable explicitly selected with TOMACCO_TESSERACT

changing_image_method.transform: RGB conversion and one top-left pixel changed per call, outside all labelled primary target rectangles; same dimensions and text. PNG preparation excluded from timing.
changing_image_method.limit: Deliberate cache-bypass recognition workload; not a moving-camera/video distribution.

interpretation_limits: Host load average 58–60 on 32 logical CPUs: timings are exploratory, not uncontended performance ceilings. Samples are sequential/unpaired and must be rerun alongside candidate measurements.
p95 uses nearest rank; n=3/4/5 groups provide only an observed maximum. Use at least 100 trials for production tail/reliability claims.

Warm cached OCR is not fresh-frame recognition or FPS. Separate changed-pixel requests assert cached=false and engine_runs>0; one changed top-left pixel preserves identical labelled text but does not model video/camera movement.
Capture copies prebuilt PNG files over a scripted fixture socket. It excludes capture/encoding on a physical device, scrcpy/USB/AirPlay transport, GPU and actual UI presentation.
CPU uses coarse /proc ticks; sampled RSS counts shared pages per process and can miss short-lived peaks. Observer sampling contributes scheduling load.
Desktop --version loads Qt offscreen and exits before Backend/window construction. It is not application startup readiness or interaction latency.
No device contact, GUI startup, build, installation, remote host or competitor runtime was used. Existing screenshot comparison medians are not matching-boundary evidence.

measured_priorities.topic: Fresh OCR engine cost and process memory
measured_priorities.evidence: Standard-route changing-pixel 2-pass warm p50 ~337–355ms vs adaptive light-panel one-pass ~159ms; changed bytes always run engines. Identical cached images are sub-millisecond. Fresh sampled RSS ~100MiB including engine processes versus ~10MiB cached MCP.
measured_priorities.next: Qualify persistent engine and bounded OpenMP policy with this exact changing-pixel matrix; compare standard and custom override separately. Reuse docs/ocr-adaptive-qualification.json full recall and ambiguity guards before changing defaults.
measured_priorities.guard: No lost labelled targets, false target centres, changed cache semantics or custom override behavior; no cached=true on changed bytes.

measured_priorities.evidence: 600-node supplied XML p50 full ~12.02ms, compact ~11.60ms; 8-node tree ~1.15–1.17ms. Compact substantially reduces output but currently does not eliminate the shared hierarchy/parse/mark-persistence cost.
measured_priorities.source: native/screen.rs tree_text reads XML, hashes, parses, numbers marks and Store.save before selecting output mode.
measured_priorities.next: Profile same 600-node XML before considering bounded digest-based parse reuse. Always read/hash fresh hierarchy and retain stale-digest refusal.
measured_priorities.guard: Target in final record remains query-accessible; references, digest checks, ambiguity and marks stay exact.

measured_priorities.evidence: Dense full vs compact wire: 90104→15305 bytes (~83% reduction), although compact text budget is 6000 characters. Small tree compact grows 1649→2175 bytes (~32%) because of structured metadata. OCR matches similarly removes full word/line payload while retaining matches.
measured_priorities.next: Use explicit task/detail modes and measure complete wire bytes. Investigate bounded optional metadata only with reference recovery preserved; do not default compact for every small tree.
measured_priorities.guard: No blind first-match selection or lost omitted-reference access; keep full detail available.

observations.claim: page_source defaults fast=true; routes source_fast/full explicitly and says a tree node is not proof it can be tapped.
source_fast asks WDA XML to exclude visible,accessible attributes and explicitly requires target verification.
summarize parses the whole XML, scores task/viewport records and emits complete records with omission counts within a character budget.

click_element success is command completion only and asks the agent to read again; Tomacco fixture tap_verify measures an additional visible hierarchy postcondition, so raw acknowledgement timings cannot be compared.

phoneuse.implication: Compare capture, hierarchy selection, read bytes, acknowledgment and verified postcondition as separate common boundaries. No speed superiority follows from code presence.

prior_research_reviewed.status: Reviewed benchmark contract only; screenshot medians are third-party unpaired reference figures and excluded from measured comparisons.
Existing source/site snapshot reviewed for context; no new current feature or speed claim made.

already_bounded: latest decoded frame per socket batch only
single H264 access-unit test prevents one-frame idle delay
native_video_read_only_audit.bounded_candidate: Measure sws_scale and createTextureFromImage per displayed frame using only generated local MJPEG/H264 socket streams. 1080×1920×4×60 = 497664000 bytes/s per RGBA pass; arithmetic only, not measured bandwidth or proof of a bottleneck.
native_video_read_only_audit.next_measurement: After explicit fixture-UI authorization, replay deterministic timestamped local packets at 30/60fps and measure packet-to-frame and frame-swapped distributions, pixel correctness, event responsiveness, CPU and RSS across 360p/1080p; no real runtime/device connections.

verification.smoke: all work types passed once before measured run

comparison_smoke.scope: same binary; verifies report matching only, not a performance improvement; fewer smoke trials
